description: Assuming GCH, for infinite kappa and lambda, kappa to the lambda is the successor of lambda if kappa is at most lambda; otherwise it is kappa below its cofinality and the successor of kappa at or above its cofinality.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ContinuumFunction.gch_powers.{u} (h : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ContinuumFunction.GCH)
  (κ τ : Cardinal.{u}) (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ) (hτ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ τ) :
  κ ^ τ = if κ ≤ τ then Order.succ τ else if τ < κ.ord.cof then κ else Order.succ κ
